image_state.basis: piecewise-constant cell averages as initial prototype; compare against refined integration, no claim of 2x physical resolution
image_state.output: sensor-area-integrated image on original native pixel grid
image_state.initialization: repeat native cell averages on 2x cells, exact native identity under integration
image_state.latent_definition: ideal pre-acquisition optical intensity with intrinsic material/intensity transition retained; F applies acquisition optics once, not a second target blur

iterations.proposal: p_t = x_t + alpha_t R_theta(x_t, U(y), U(y-F_kappa(x_t)), calibration, local noise cues)
iterations.observation_step: x_next = p_t - eta_t grad_x L_observed(F_kappa(p_t), y); no ineffective proximity term
iterations.step_size_rule: For initial calibrated linear/quadratic likelihood, positive eta <= 1/L with an independent upper bound for the implemented noise-weighted F including boundaries. Record a finite calibrated variance floor. Nonlinear/censored likelihood needs its own bound; otherwise no qualified step.
iterations.identity_contract: Initialization integrates exactly to Raw. Whole-model no-op is required for identity optics/noiseless correct input or explicit unchanged-output fallback, not for arbitrary blurred Raw under nonidentity F.

learned_prior.activation: SiLU; exact choice engineering proposal, not a validated advantage

forward_model.initial_family: local intensity PSF, pixel area integration, measured radiometric response and noise likelihood
forward_model.psf_centroid: measured calibration datum; cannot float per evaluated object or be silently recentered
forward_model.fallback_when_mismatched: report unqualified; direct reconstruction may remain an exploratory control, never relabel it as physics-qualified
forward_model.saturation: censored likelihood or explicit unsupported flag; never treat clipped value as exact latent truth

geometry.representation: general boundary likelihood and signed distance plus position/size uncertainty
geometry.role: training auxiliary and exposed diagnostic; does not freely warp or overwrite the image
geometry.supervision: independent synthetic geometry and, only when available, separately sourced real training SEM correspondences
geometry.image_consistency: two-way comparison of geometry and actual rendered image; independent external measurement remains decisive
geometry.consistency_convention: Compare a fixed qualified observation/geometry mapping; until qualified retain disagreement as diagnostic, never equate SEM material edge automatically to optical half-level.
geometry.head_inputs: final latent image x_T and fixed local intensity cues, two 3x3 convolutions, no extra learned warp
geometry.evaluation: fixed external image metrics first; head agreement is diagnostic until independently qualified mapping/tolerance exists

tiling.halo_status: analytical design bound only; runtime impulse/gradient and tile tests still required
tiling.proof_recipe: rF = sampling_factor*kernel_radius + sampling_factor-1; rPrior = stem+head+2*sum(dilations); conservative native radius = ceil(outer_steps*(3*rF+rPrior)/sampling_factor)+conditioner_radius+ceil(geometry_head_radius/sampling_factor)+1

precision: Observation/geometry arithmetic FP32; optional prior AMP must pass parity and memory smoke tests for every compared model before protocol freeze
